goal_in_sim: Plant output looks fine on the dashboard but the owner says revenue is down. Find out why and fix it.
failure: INV-3's comms card failed at 09:30. The inverter safe-stopped at 0 kW, but SCADA still shows its last report (980.75 kW, running) with last_update stuck at 09:29, and no alarm was raised.
failed_to_be: a running central inverter exporting about 1.2 MW, like INV-1, INV-2 and INV-4

evidence.sensors: Dashboard sum 4573 kW vs revenue meter 3558 kW at 11:00 (gap 1015 kW, about one inverter). INV-3's ac_kw, dc_kw, heatsink_c and fan_rpm have not changed since 09:29; the other units update every minute. No alarms.
evidence.camera: INV-3's display is dark; INV-1, INV-2 and INV-4 are lit and show their output.
evidence.infrared: INV-3's upper louvre reads 29.7 C and its cabinet max 35.5 C at 28.5 C ambient, vs 38.2 to 39.2 C and 39.7 to 40.4 C on the running units: it is not making heat, so it is not converting power, though SCADA reports a 32.1 C heatsink.

cost_so_far.basis: mean of INV-1, INV-2 and INV-4 each minute
